title: [S06] Isolate acquisition from graph writes with a complete capture sink
checkout_note: The similarly named nested directory is an untracked copy, not the working checkout used for this repair.

prerequisites.DEF-45: in review; not accepted and not claimed as accepted here

actual_enabled_path: Registry construction forwards enricher kwargs to WebsiteToLinks.
WebsiteToLinks.__init__ selects capture_only only when no graph_service was injected, and rejects an injected non-capture repository.
create_graph_service constructs CaptureGraphRepository without importing Logger or constructing Neo4jGraphRepository.
WebsiteToLinks.scan runs the real reconspread.Crawler, captures direct callback candidates inside source_context, catches per-source exceptions, and returns unreviewed candidates with source lineage.
WebsiteToLinks.postprocess performs no publication; Enricher.execute reaches final GraphService.flush(), which is local capture-batch flush only.
required_properties: Capture candidates are explicitly disposition=unreviewed and retain input_index/source_url lineage.
Capture mode has no live-service fallback and no fabricated Neo4j element identifiers.
Reads, queries, deletes, updates, merges, and relationship lookup fail with explicit NotImplementedError and are captured as unsupported publication intent.
Batch threshold flush is a local capture event; capture candidates are retained before and after flushing.
No constructor/import path requires Neo4j credentials or opens a connection in capture mode.
The four fixtures use WebsiteToLinks' enabled crawler path and a loopback HTTP server, never a simulated crawler.

analysis_boundaries.blast: Pip3r provides static coverage only. Dynamic registry/kwargs edges are recorded as UNKNOWN and traced manually above.
analysis_boundaries.external_io: Loopback-only test HTTP server; no real-site collection, push, merge, deploy, or live graph write.

review_gate: Independent reviewer must inspect the repair diff. Any finding fix must be sent to that same reviewer for re-verification before Linear moves to In Review.
